description: Election Commission - A. R. M. Rahuman and A. G. F. Ameen Selected as the Members of the Kuchchaveli P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of vacancies in a local government body (Kuchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes - declaring elected members to fill vacancies caused by a member ceasing to belong to a party and by death. This falls under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral procedures, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for local government positions.
